name: guide-discovery
description: Questions someone setting up, deploying, or troubleshooting docusaurus-plugin-mcp-server would ask, put to an agent connected only to this site's MCP server. A case passes when the answer carries facts that only the matching guide gives.

cases.input: I maintain a Docusaurus 3 documentation site and want AI agents to be able to search it over MCP. What exactly do I install and configure, and how do I check it works before I deploy anything?
My Docusaurus site already builds with the MCP plugin. How do I deploy the MCP endpoint to Vercel so it's served at /mcp? List the files I need to add.
My Docusaurus site already builds with the MCP plugin. How do I deploy its MCP endpoint on Netlify, at /mcp?
I want to host my Docusaurus site and its MCP endpoint on Cloudflare Workers. What's the setup?
My Docusaurus docs are hosted on GitHub Pages. Can the MCP server run there too? If not, what should I do instead?

cases.description: Finds the 406 symptom in the troubleshooting guide
cases.input: Tool calls to my deployed docs MCP endpoint return 406 Not Acceptable when I test them with curl. What's wrong, and what's the fix?

cases.description: Finds the /mcp 404 symptom and gives the platform's routing fix
cases.input: I deployed my Docusaurus site with the MCP plugin to Netlify. The docs work, but https://my-docs.netlify.app/mcp shows my site's 404 page. What should I check?
One of my Docusaurus pages has a setup procedure. How do I mark it up so AI agents can follow it step by step, and check that it worked? Show me the markup.
